scope: Extend the existing native replay and real authority observer; no replacement harness, mock ammo, synthetic success flags or normal-user configuration changes
current_execution_limit: Existing strict normal hold regression only; insertion/recovery needs a separately compiled observer handoff and measured pose waypoints before it can run
existing_hold_prefix: Verify immutable package and source identity, native deployment hashes, actual selected pointer and saved configuration snapshots
Require Steam Client API initialized1 and the exact normal observer-ready marker; engine/world progress is diagnostic only
Observe clean real loaded/reserve baseline, one native-input shot, accepted exact paid removal and 12second hold
Require world-weapon/experimental gates false; keep dropped ammunition recovery enabled according to the declared preset

required_observer_extension.handoff: Retain the strict existing hold prefix and its warnings, then hand off its test-only completion/quit behavior to a separately checked lifecycle observer; never let the hold analyzer silently accept ammo increases or identity changes
required_observer_extension.geometry: Read-only samples of world/room wrist and palm poses, actual loose prop/ground position, grip edges, insertion entry/seat/contact frames and pouch positions; record source data rather than guess a generic magwell
required_observer_extension.identities: Record full source weapon, pawn and registry paths plus world/pawn lifetime, ownership revision, exact paid token and receipt serial
required_observer_extension.accounting: Read authoritative game loaded/reserve and every seen paid ledger token; reconcile props, carrier hand, native feed flags, confirmed shot costs, explicit grants and accepted live discard
required_observer_extension.completion: Require observed claim, release, insertion or pouch receipts and settled snapshots for every requested phase. Missing events or runtime warnings fail; no text fixture constitutes game evidence

steam_failure_stop.trigger: Steam Client API initialized0 followed by STEAM is required; zero observer samples
steam_failure_stop.action: Stop runtime retries and restore. User must finish/close their active VR session, exit SteamVR and Steam normally, reopen Steam and confirm signed-in/online, then reopen SteamVR. Do not restart or alter their session automatically
